Other Repositories (Pinned)

  • omarchy-unifi-protect 20 6
    Omarchy bar widget: watch your UniFi Protect cameras from the bar
  • omarchy-workspace-name 30 7
    Omarchy bar widget: name the current workspace, and see the name in the bar
  • omasweeper 14 2
    Minesweeper as an Omarchy shell plugin, drawn like a TUI
  • omarchy-time-machine 144 11
    Scheduled restic backups for Omarchy, with a snapshot browser in the bar
  • omarchy-herdr 57 12
    Running herdr servers in the Omarchy bar, with every agent inside them, and a click that lands you on the one you picked
  • omarchy-clippy 26 3
    A paperclip in the corner of your Omarchy desktop that follows your mouse and hands out tips from the manual.

Omarchy apps

Bigger things than a bar widget: full apps that wear your Omarchy theme.

Meeting Recorder

Records your mic and the computer audio as two tracks, and transcribes the meeting on your own machine, with speakers, chapters and a player.

Sequencer

A step sequencer with a TR-808 kit, 90s rave sounds, effects on every track, free sound packs and recording from your microphone.

 
yay -S omarchy-meeting-recorder-bin
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jankeesvw/omarchy-sequencer/main/install.sh | bash

Omarchy plugins

Small things for the Omarchy bar, mostly built because I wanted them myself. Install any of them with omarchy plugin add <repo url>, or find them in the plugin marketplace.

# Plugin What it does Marketplace
1 Time Machine Scheduled restic backups, with a snapshot browser in the bar jankeesvw.time-machine
2 Tesla Where your car is, how full it is, and how far that gets you, without keeping it awake jankeesvw.tesla
3 Notification Center Every notification you were sent, kept and readable again jankeesvw.notification-center
4 Herdr Running herdr servers, every agent inside them, and a click that lands you on the one you picked jankeesvw.herdr
5 Workspace name Name the current workspace, and see that name in the bar jankeesvw.workspace-name
6 UniFi Protect Watch your UniFi Protect cameras from the bar jankeesvw.unifi-protect
7 Downloads Recent downloads, in a window you can drag files out of jankeesvw.downloads
8 Gmail Inbox Unread count in the bar, sender and subject in the panel jankeesvw.gmail-inbox
9 Omasweeper Minesweeper, drawn like a TUI jankeesvw.omasweeper
10 Text Transform Rewrite, translate or fix text with the coding agent Omarchy already runs jankeesvw.text-transform
11 Bambu Lab Chamber camera, AMS spools, progress and stop, over your own network jankeesvw.bambu-lab
12 GitHub Build Monitor Whether the branch you deploy from is green right now jankeesvw.github-build-monitor
13 Meetings Your day as a column, with a line where you are in it jankeesvw.meetings
14 Stripe MRR Your recurring revenue in the bar, latest payments in the panel, optional gold ingot jankeesvw.stripe-mrr
15 Screen Time Screen time for kids, as a budget that locks at zero or as an agreement with no locks at all submitted
16 Nag Set an alarm by typing one line, and see what it understood before you commit jankeesvw.nag
17 Omableep Retro soundboard: chip sounds synthesised on the spot, machine sounds from real recordings jankeesvw.omableep
18 Clippy The paperclip is back: follows your mouse, hands out tips from the Omarchy manual, and tells you when your agent is done jankeesvw.clippy
19 Framework Desktop RGB A colour wheel for the fan LEDs of the Framework Desktop, or let them follow your theme jankeesvw.framework-desktop-rgb

Omarchy themes

Themes install differently to plugins, with omarchy theme install <repo url>, and then omarchy theme set to switch to one later.

# Theme What it looks like
1 WBSO.ai Light: white surfaces, a deep blue accent, amber highlights and navy text
2 Phosphor MS-DOS blue with mint, built around an illustration by Timo Kuilder
